Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "David Copperfield", "unit": 34, "heading": "CHAPTER 32. THE BEGINNING OF A LONG JOURNEY", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "en85-u034-b0094", "target": "Я сразу увидел по лицу его матери, что она знает от него самого, что он сделал. Оно было очень бледно и несло следы более глубокого волнения, чем могло бы породить одно моё письмо, ослабленное сомнениями, которые подсказала бы ей её привязанность. Мне показалось, что она похожа на него больше, чем когда-либо прежде; и я почувствовал, скорее чем увидел, что это сходство не ускользнуло от моего спутника.", "source_sha256": "03d6c6f601c4e51647f58d38c57c04cd6150462001d82f99dd1c64cfe09d50cb", "target_id": "ru-en85-u034-b0094", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "3d63d2012006040f6f15aa7369750699c216d45a0651acb69da3fa182a446489"}, {"source_id": "en85-u034-b0095", "target": "Она сидела прямо в своём кресле с величавым, неподвижным, бесстрастным видом, который, казалось, ничто не могло нарушить. Она очень пристально смотрела на мистера Пегготи, когда он стоял перед ней; и он смотрел на неё столь же пристально. Острый взгляд Розы Дартл охватывал всех нас. Несколько мгновений не было произнесено ни слова.", "source_sha256": "1022043ef65ce5a4a0c5bfec76bc6ddb9ff50c86bc42ce781b08e1191c86912f", "target_id": "ru-en85-u034-b0095", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "25dcbd71b7568dc3e61eab00b74f2f0bf6ff0a3e0827c7f74a96e2ccb9cea295"}], "source_language": "English", "part": null, "book": null, "chapter": 32, "role": "chapter"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "en85-u034-b0096", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "She motioned to Mr. Peggotty to be seated. He said, in a low voice, ‘I shouldn’t feel it nat’ral, ma’am, to sit down in this house. I’d sooner stand.’ And this was succeeded by another silence, which she broke thus:", "sha256": "0acd1f332b66557763f3db7bf7a03b7ad7928bf88cd1f82d2f7c49a85c55ca84", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[96]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0097", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I know, with deep regret, what has brought you here. What do you want of me? What do you ask me to do?’", "sha256": "cc76c0da3775a0d780d246d1e677be144b9d573d153d7fa40c918b7b9e600829", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[97]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0098", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "He put his hat under his arm, and feeling in his breast for Emily’s letter, took it out, unfolded it, and gave it to her. ‘Please to read that, ma’am. That’s my niece’s hand!’", "sha256": "84f4110ebccfeea66347795fd983f61e32377401dc4427d873bbf164b467b48e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[98]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0099", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "She read it, in the same stately and impassive way,—untouched by its contents, as far as I could see,—and returned it to him.", "sha256": "7c2e049c8f0d12f3b7548cff5700aa14310111697e6f486c47a808969bcd02d4", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[99]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0100", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘“Unless he brings me back a lady,”’ said Mr. Peggotty, tracing out that part with his finger. ‘I come to know, ma’am, whether he will keep his wured?’", "sha256": "06defeda910f4ecfc878b73453de41d4153a65fce5f9378f021486bff67646ce", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[100]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0101", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘No,’ she returned.", "sha256": "5385bd23c13da15972c90fa96fa65fc65052c5de50a0ce46041fbc94e3708323", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[101]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0102", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Why not?’ said Mr. Peggotty.", "sha256": "ac5f39db0c8f762b06c6c041aa48fbd74d614a6e18cedc34259fd7c69d3eab52", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[102]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0103", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘It is impossible. He would disgrace himself. You cannot fail to know that she is far below him.’", "sha256": "cc0174761fc14e05ffe5039ff573c43c34ec4af64977f862a5c6cb0ca2b53d88", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[103]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0104", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Raise her up!’ said Mr. Peggotty.", "sha256": "35ff93ee2c93be25863e637889c509d0275ea59c543319fb7924e22bcb62addb", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[104]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0105", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘She is uneducated and ignorant.’", "sha256": "4a381cd84998ca46d8ff2f7a442c54b529ed5959931d2851349e92e49fc7d6f3", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[105]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0106", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Maybe she’s not; maybe she is,’ said Mr. Peggotty. ‘I think not, ma’am; but I’m no judge of them things. Teach her better!’", "sha256": "d73af0eb1f97b6e3dd3f1c4942accb131fc28e2ffa0612f1814ec2612f270809", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[106]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0107", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Since you oblige me to speak more plainly, which I am very unwilling to do, her humble connexions would render such a thing impossible, if nothing else did.’", "sha256": "f817676892b5bcb0a5596f38610051f9a60e63a380c29c7aa2907d3be7544a57", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[107]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0108", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Hark to this, ma’am,’ he returned, slowly and quietly. ‘You know what it is to love your child. So do I. If she was a hundred times my child, I couldn’t love her more. You doen’t know what it is to lose your child. I do. All the heaps of riches in the wureld would be nowt to me (if they was mine) to buy her back! But, save her from this disgrace, and she shall never be disgraced by us. Not one of us that she’s growed up among, not one of us that’s lived along with her and had her for their all in all, these many year, will ever look upon her pritty face again. We’ll be content to let her be; we’ll be content to think of her, far off, as if she was underneath another sun and sky; we’ll be content to trust her to her husband,—to her little children, p’raps,—and bide the time when all of us shall be alike in quality afore our God!’", "sha256": "e60bac0d21fd4ec797064728ef1862e635715ef03e50baed657467cbd90395db", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[108]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0109", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "The rugged eloquence with which he spoke, was not devoid of all effect. She still preserved her proud manner, but there was a touch of softness in her voice, as she answered:", "sha256": "1da3edd4f54639fdc54363aa744886c6e38befe7a4788bb5e5b24d182523ba9b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[109]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0110", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I justify nothing. I make no counter-accusations. But I am sorry to repeat, it is impossible. Such a marriage would irretrievably blight my son’s career, and ruin his prospects. Nothing is more certain than that it never can take place, and never will. If there is any other compensation—’", "sha256": "1a7594748f241966b05b7e6514bed6a4a149e1c5379ea1f3494bcfa16a6d0a19", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[110]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0111", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I am looking at the likeness of the face,’ interrupted Mr. Peggotty, with a steady but a kindling eye, ‘that has looked at me, in my home, at my fireside, in my boat—wheer not?—-smiling and friendly, when it was so treacherous, that I go half wild when I think of it. If the likeness of that face don’t turn to burning fire, at the thought of offering money to me for my child’s blight and ruin, it’s as bad. I doen’t know, being a lady’s, but what it’s worse.’", "sha256": "2e3a9600a59fc7126da12e7d00c6d03a6b6d5c6d3cb8aed40186cbb2f203c073", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[111]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0112", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "She changed now, in a moment. An angry flush overspread her features; and she said, in an intolerant manner, grasping the arm-chair tightly with her hands:", "sha256": "1f21daf3b3b1c875982288607962afb7a0d83155923727d37860f4fa1a477d28", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[112]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0113", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘What compensation can you make to ME for opening such a pit between me and my son? What is your love to mine? What is your separation to ours?’", "sha256": "9aa27bee09f2bcaf4f1f20977722bdaea1ecda0d1df6b3b1c7bfe7202001fd17", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[113]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0114", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Miss Dartle softly touched her, and bent down her head to whisper, but she would not hear a word.", "sha256": "cf72817c6b115cb445796a6f163dd8fd244749aea8c2b25212be43a401e6687f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[114]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0115", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘No, Rosa, not a word! Let the man listen to what I say! My son, who has been the object of my life, to whom its every thought has been devoted, whom I have gratified from a child in every wish, from whom I have had no separate existence since his birth,—to take up in a moment with a miserable girl, and avoid me! To repay my confidence with systematic deception, for her sake, and quit me for her! To set this wretched fancy, against his mother’s claims upon his duty, love, respect, gratitude—claims that every day and hour of his life should have strengthened into ties that nothing could be proof against! Is this no injury?’", "sha256": "70ca5bcb2544a43da47af2d5488d51065503de2a492d6d1332ee5aad5829ba17", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[115]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0116", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Again Rosa Dartle tried to soothe her; again ineffectually.", "sha256": "b39a67923c7a021d1316f863e1da84855cdebf6d5ac1580906624276efc5cfae", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[116]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0117", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I say, Rosa, not a word! If he can stake his all upon the lightest object, I can stake my all upon a greater purpose. Let him go where he will, with the means that my love has secured to him! Does he think to reduce me by long absence? He knows his mother very little if he does. Let him put away his whim now, and he is welcome back. Let him not put her away now, and he never shall come near me, living or dying, while I can raise my hand to make a sign against it, unless, being rid of her for ever, he comes humbly to me and begs for my forgiveness. This is my right. This is the acknowledgement I WILL HAVE. This is the separation that there is between us! And is this,’ she added, looking at her visitor with the proud intolerant air with which she had begun, ‘no injury?’", "sha256": "b3379d38d5dfc2aabbe1592155560eccf111f058fee3bdf505fd791f521b7d31", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[117]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0118", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "While I heard and saw the mother as she said these words, I seemed to hear and see the son, defying them. All that I had ever seen in him of an unyielding, wilful spirit, I saw in her. All the understanding that I had now of his misdirected energy, became an understanding of her character too, and a perception that it was, in its strongest springs, the same.", "sha256": "0df878d283d99baf9fa6b9b9d4606845885499645458642633153e6e4d333f57", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[118]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0119", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "She now observed to me, aloud, resuming her former restraint, that it was useless to hear more, or to say more, and that she begged to put an end to the interview. She rose with an air of dignity to leave the room, when Mr. Peggotty signified that it was needless.", "sha256": "117ce0568bb151130d0100ee9f490c3cb6333d153bebcdcc2097720679014489", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[119]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0120", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Doen’t fear me being any hindrance to you, I have no more to say, ma’am,’ he remarked, as he moved towards the door. ‘I come heer with no hope, and I take away no hope. I have done what I thowt should be done, but I never looked fur any good to come of my stan’ning where I do. This has been too evil a house fur me and mine, fur me to be in my right senses and expect it.’", "sha256": "6cb04ab51ab8c17ac7a946bfe04fd4a32dd47d048da08ee99dec7dc036bc4ba4", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[120]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0121", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "With this, we departed; leaving her standing by her elbow-chair, a picture of a noble presence and a handsome face.", "sha256": "b54e17c1de80a80708d03b708807b4f8c25f51d06e7b008c5d3ef92d196c3969", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[121]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0122", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "We had, on our way out, to cross a paved hall, with glass sides and roof, over which a vine was trained. Its leaves and shoots were green then, and the day being sunny, a pair of glass doors leading to the garden were thrown open. Rosa Dartle, entering this way with a noiseless step, when we were close to them, addressed herself to me:", "sha256": "2b3e682fd7852c40ec0fe1a80b21c34e30687267ade3f2b258922e855cdd38bd", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[122]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0123", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘You do well,’ she said, ‘indeed, to bring this fellow here!’", "sha256": "fa715aff6b5b356ce1f4e4b149a0c58b3cc1afc4568ce025359fc6f173d8c97d", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[123]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0124", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Such a concentration of rage and scorn as darkened her face, and flashed in her jet-black eyes, I could not have thought compressible even into that face. The scar made by the hammer was, as usual in this excited state of her features, strongly marked. When the throbbing I had seen before, came into it as I looked at her, she absolutely lifted up her hand, and struck it.", "sha256": "8a9c074fd4f56bc88036cbf5febdb832c3e1f90dd1d6a26b1eae38f68f68fcb4", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[124]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0125", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘This is a fellow,’ she said, ‘to champion and bring here, is he not? You are a true man!’", "sha256": "8b6521734458562b313fe85bcb38fc1c415fce552294abdcc1d5578b8a3372b5", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[125]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0126", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Miss Dartle,’ I returned, ‘you are surely not so unjust as to condemn ME!’", "sha256": "31f763c4a4f465f3e8e33e97a8b9b149322c6d586a12b180d3cb766fd14a0f4b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[126]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0127", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Why do you bring division between these two mad creatures?’ she returned. ‘Don’t you know that they are both mad with their own self-will and pride?’", "sha256": "7bde80b2cd37b4ddc99f854213eaa5880b31ff6b65ccc10a7bd9bc521a4907ab", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[127]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}]}
